entities.name: Dark's Keep
entities.description: A fortress on Madara near its western coast, home of Ramses Overdark, destroyed in the Madara-Edemi War.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Island on which Dark's Keep stood.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Imperial Assassin who lived in the keep and was also called Lord Dark.

entities.name: Suido River
entities.description: River a branch of which surrounded the keep.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which the keep was destroyed.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Bogardan seismic mage who destroyed the keep.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Gave the order to destroy the keep.

events.summary: Kolo Meha destroys Dark's Keep under the instruction of Tetsuo Umezawa during the Madara-Edemi War.
events.quote: the keep was destroyed by the Bogardan Seismic Mage Kolo Meha under the instruction of Tetsuo Umezawa

relations.note: The fortress stood near Madara's western coast.
relations.quote: Dark's Keep was a fortress on the island of Madara

relations.note: The keep was his home and named for him.
relations.quote: This structure was home to the Imperial Assassin Ramses Overdark
